title: Delinquent Loop Pre-execution Using Predicated Helper Threads
problem: Helper-thread branch pre-execution fails when delinquent branches are control-dependent on other delinquent branches: prior work must branch-predict the first delinquent branch (b1) in the helper thread to decide whether to pre-execute the second (b2), merely shifting the misprediction bottleneck to the helper thread. Additionally, stores that both influence a delinquent branch and are control-dependent on it create a disambiguation problem in helper threads.
motivation: Hard-to-predict branches remain a fundamental IPC limiter in modern CPUs, and helper-thread pre-execution is a promising approach, but its scalability to nested delinquent control dependences has been an unresolved challenge.
method: Phelps creates a helper thread for each inner loop containing hard-to-predict branches and runs every such branch unconditionally (without guessing which way it goes first) in every loop iteration, including branches that depend on other branch outcomes. It tracks the results of each branch separately in queues synchronized with loop iterations, so the main thread can use whichever results are needed based on how branches actually execute. Memory writes that both influence a hard-to-predict branch and depend on its outcome are marked as conditional on that branch's outcome within the helper thread. For nested loops where the inner loop's iteration count is short or unpredictable, a dual helper-thread setup handles the inner and outer loops independently.
key_novelty: The key innovation is unconditionally running all hard-to-predict branches—even those dependent on other branches—instead of predicting them in the helper thread, using per-branch queues kept synchronized with loop iterations.
contributions: Phelps: predicated helper thread design that handles chains of control-dependent delinquent branches without helper-thread branch prediction
Loop-iteration-lockstep per-branch queue management enabling correct ordered delivery of pre-executed outcomes
Predicated store handling for stores that are both influential and control-dependent on delinquent branches
Dual decoupled helper thread mechanism for outer-inner loop pairs with unpredictable inner trip counts
baselines: Prior helper thread branch pre-execution approaches
limitations: Not discussed; quantitative performance results are absent from the abstract.
primary_theme: predicated helper threads for delinquent branch pre-execution
